facts.value: WUE status is available for first-year students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of eight semesters, beginning with their first term of enrollment at ASU.
WUE status is available for two-year community college transfer students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of 5 semesters, beginning with their first term of enrollment at ASU.
WUE status is available for four-year institution transfer students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of 120 credit hours, including all transfer credits.
Students must maintain continuous enrollment which is defined as enrollment in both fall and spring semesters with summer sessions not included.
Summer sessions and consortium agreement classes, repeated classes, incomplete grades or audited classes, and any credits received by examination, including AP, CLEP, IB and other tests.
Students must maintain a minimum ASU cumulative GPA.
Students are expected to enroll in classes at their designated campus location.
